baseline.scope: typed Domain capabilities; declarative operations inventoried separately
baseline.note: This catalog is a test plan, not proof that any case passed.

release_rule: No critical FAIL/BLOCKED; full scope and independent live acceptance required

cases.title: Immutable inventory
cases.procedure: Enumerate typed and descriptive capabilities by owner, revision and release SHA
cases.expected: No unknown/executable-only bindings; descriptive entries are not marked executable

cases.title: Ownership
cases.procedure: Every typed capability has one Domain owner and non-conflicting ID
cases.expected: Exactly one owner and no duplicate canonical identifier

cases.title: Exposure classification
cases.procedure: Separate public, internal and deprecated/retired operations
cases.expected: Internal Plan Approval cannot appear as user-plannable work

cases.title: Uncontracted operations
cases.procedure: Map live Domain methods without typed contracts
cases.expected: Every uncontracted business operation is marked backlog/unavailable, not PASS

cases.title: Cohort freeze
cases.procedure: Pin active module, tenant, version and contract digest at run start
cases.expected: Denominator immutable for the evaluated test run

cases.title: Input schema
cases.procedure: Validate valid, malformed, unknown and oversized inputs before dispatch
cases.expected: Invalid payload has zero domain side effects

cases.title: Output schema
cases.procedure: Validate direct result and Action result against pinned output definition
cases.expected: Mismatch is ERROR/RECONCILE; never silently report business success

cases.title: Version and digest
cases.procedure: Change schema/contract bytes after immutable Plan is proposed
cases.expected: Stale Plan refuses new execution without explicit migration

cases.title: Risk policy
cases.procedure: Verify kind, effect level, permission, approval and retry/timeouts
cases.expected: Mutations have correct policy and explicit idempotency/failure contract

cases.title: Compatibility lifecycle
cases.procedure: Test stable, experimental, deprecated and retired revisions
cases.expected: Deprecated/retired capability is not newly executable; historical evidence remains readable

cases.title: Actual handler
cases.procedure: Resolve adapter or Action handler from running container
cases.expected: No missing, conflicting, incorrect-owner or orphan handler accepted

cases.title: Canonical dispatch
cases.procedure: Trace CommandBus, QueryBus or Kernel Action from one request
cases.expected: No second generic executor or direct database writer

cases.title: Module availability
cases.procedure: Disable the owning Domain for a tenant
cases.expected: Capability becomes unavailable and cannot execute

cases.title: Fleet parity
cases.procedure: Compare API, worker and scheduler contract digests/handler maps
cases.expected: Drift blocks execution rather than selecting a preferred handler

cases.title: Readiness boundary
cases.procedure: Compare declaration, handler registration and tenant permission
cases.expected: Each is reported separately; none implies completed Outcome

cases.title: Human UI
cases.procedure: Execute valid manager operation via session, origin and CSRF
cases.expected: Correct operation uses canonical gateway/policy; native result verified

cases.title: Human API
cases.procedure: Execute same allowed operation via guarded authenticated API
cases.expected: Same contract, authorization and receipt semantics as UI

cases.title: AI origin
cases.procedure: Attempt direct mutation and authorized intent-only route
cases.expected: Direct mutation rejected; intent pending review, not performed

cases.title: CRON origin
cases.procedure: Attempt replayed signed automation intent
cases.expected: Scoped authenticated intent stored once, with no unauthorized Action start

cases.title: Event origin
cases.procedure: Attempt unregistered and registered reactive triggers
cases.expected: Untrusted event denied; trusted event yields only policy-evaluated intent

cases.title: Least privilege
cases.procedure: Attempt invocation with absent/mismatched permission
cases.expected: Fail-closed with no domain side effect

cases.title: Tenant isolation
cases.procedure: Read or write cross-tenant object using native ID
cases.expected: Tenant isolation enforced at gateway, handler and outcome readback

cases.title: Identity anti-spoof
cases.procedure: Submit tenant, actor, correlation or origin overrides in payload
cases.expected: Server-derived identity authoritative; forged fields rejected

cases.title: Human approval
cases.procedure: Attempt regulated Action before Plan and Action approval
cases.expected: No Action worker execution before independent approvals

cases.title: Self-approval
cases.procedure: Use plan author as approver or invalid/stale approval
cases.expected: No self-approval, implicit auto-approval or approval replay

cases.title: Pure preflight
cases.procedure: Validate a plan without mutating persisted state
cases.expected: No Plan/Run/Action is written by dry-run validation

cases.title: Immutable plan
cases.procedure: Re-propose equivalent Plan and mutate pinned input afterwards
cases.expected: Same identity does not create duplicate; altered pinned input blocked

cases.title: Single writer
cases.procedure: Start and advance an authorized Workflow Run
cases.expected: One authority per Run/Step and one Domain action dispatch

cases.title: Step receipt
cases.procedure: Complete one approved Action through real worker
cases.expected: Pinned attempt and output receipt persist with correct provenance

cases.title: Independent checkpoint
cases.procedure: Complete technical Run without native business evidence
cases.expected: Goal does not become satisfied without Domain outcome verifier

cases.title: Exact repeat
cases.procedure: Repeat same request and idempotency key
cases.expected: Same durable receipt, exactly one business effect

cases.title: Key conflict
cases.procedure: Repeat same key with different normalized input
cases.expected: Conflict rejected without second mutation

cases.title: Concurrency
cases.procedure: Race identical invocations or Action claims
cases.expected: At most one writer/claim and one effect

cases.title: Crash boundary
cases.procedure: Inject failure after native write before receipt checkpoint
cases.expected: Recovery reconciles existing effect and never blindly replays

cases.title: Ambiguity recovery
cases.procedure: Simulate remote timeout or unknown external outcome
cases.expected: AMBIGUOUS quarantined for operator reconciliation

cases.title: Native readback
cases.procedure: Re-read created/updated object from owning Domain
cases.expected: Native state matches contract, tenant and pinned input

cases.title: Relationship proof
cases.procedure: Verify cross-domain entity references and cardinality
cases.expected: Every relation points to unique tenant-native ID

cases.title: Complete evidence
cases.procedure: Verify Plan, Action, receipt, native result and evaluation chain
cases.expected: No success on Workflow status or synthetic fixture alone

cases.title: Missing or revoked proof
cases.procedure: Remove/expire one required receipt or native relation
cases.expected: Positive Goal evaluation blocked or invalidated on reassessment

cases.title: Independent evaluation
cases.procedure: Run separate authorized Goal evaluator after completion
cases.expected: Immutable evaluation records criterion, evidence policy and result

cases.title: Transactional publish
cases.procedure: Emit Domain event through existing transaction/outbox boundary
cases.expected: Committed mutation has durable event or explicit documented alternative

cases.title: Event provenance
cases.procedure: Validate source, type, version, tenant and correlation
cases.expected: Forged, stale, incompatible or cross-tenant event rejected

cases.title: Subscription authorization
cases.procedure: Resolve event consumer and capability allowlist
cases.expected: Unlisted event cannot invoke a mutation or bypass approval

cases.title: Consumer idempotency
cases.procedure: Deliver same event twice and out of order
cases.expected: Exactly one logical effect; late event cannot override newer state

cases.title: Loop and dead letter
cases.procedure: Inject consumer failure or recursive trigger
cases.expected: Bounded retries, observable dead letter and no uncontrolled loop

cases.title: Isolation
cases.procedure: Run mutations only in approved non-production tenant with safe fixtures
cases.expected: No production external sends, financial actions or real customer side effects

cases.title: Deployment parity
cases.procedure: Pin same release SHA/schema/migrations across workers and API
cases.expected: Mismatched build or missing migration blocks acceptance

cases.title: Observability
cases.procedure: Correlate Goal, Plan, Run, Step, Action, native entity and event
cases.expected: Operator can explain each outcome and every rejection

cases.title: Rollback
cases.procedure: Exercise feature-flag stop, safe recovery and forward-only evidence retention
cases.expected: No duplicate execution, data loss or silent side-effect replay

cases.title: Operator sign-off
cases.procedure: Collect full test matrix plus two-human independent acceptance
cases.expected: Release only on exact final SHA, zero P0 blockers and signed evidence
